messages:
Iris: Weekend choice  alfresco movie in the park Sat 7:30pm or night market crawl + dumpling stand 8pm? quick votes :movie_camera::dumpling:
Ben: Movie for me. bring a sweater, last time it got chilly after sunset.
Sofia: Night market! dumplings > movies, but i'll go to the movie if it's the new sci-fi short block.
Tom: leaning night market. can we grab a table at the dumpling stall? heard they fill fast.
Iris: i can try to reserve a picnic table near the movie screen but not sure they're allowed. ops-bot, any park rules?
ops-bot: Park reminder: amplified sound and reserved picnic areas require a permit. No reserve for movie blanket seating. Night market is vendor-run and open to public.
Ben: ok movie people, we'll spread blankets. i'll bring a thermos of hot cocoa.
Sofia: who wants vegetarian dumplings? the night market stall has veggie and spicy tofu options.
Tom: vegetarian for me, add spicy tofu if available.
Iris: vote with just "movie" or "market"
Ben: movie
Sofia: market
Tom: market
Iris: tally 2 market, 1 movie. still close. i'll hold both plans until 5pm Sat and then post final.
Sofia: logistics q: market starts at 6:30, stalls open til 11pm. any transit heads-up?
ops-bot: Transit notice: Night market shuttle runs until 10:30pm from 3rd & Pine. Limited bike racks by the park main entrance.
Tom: i'll drive if we want seats, have room for two.
Ben: if movie wins, i'll meet by the north gate at 7pm to help claim good blanket spots.
Iris: agree to do both: final send at 5pm. if market wins we'll meet at 7:45 at vendor row A. if movie wins, north gate 7pm.
Sofia: small favor: can someone bring a portable charger to the market? my phone dies fast with photos.
Tom: bringing charger and an extra poncho in case of mist.
Ben: cocoa still on. see y'all this weekend whichever plan sticks :thumbsup:
Iris: thanks everyone. i'll post final plan by 5pm and drop a quick location photo. have a good day! :sunny:
